Interesting facts
Paint appeared on May 18, 2017.
The paint was first sold in the shop for USD currency then it was moved to be sold in the garage for tankoins on April 10th, 2020.
The source of this paint's brilliant orange color is Iron Oxide, the same compound that gives the planet Mars its distinctive hue.
